lines.zh: 叶片沙沙作响，轻灵步履。
森林边缘轻跃，绿光闪烁。
踏着苔痕，跟在主人身侧
lines.en: It pads on moss, keeping to its master's side.
Leaves part as it slips through.

lines.zh: 栖息于古木之上，目光深邃。
它把爪子搭在你的书页上
lines.en: It rests a paw on your open page.

lines.zh: 它在林间嗅着魔力的味道
lines.en: It sniffs the forest for traces of magic.
It curls up on the familiar bed and dozes.
Its ears swivel toward the deep woods.
It nudges the tome close to itself.
Fixes you with a sharp gaze.

lines.zh: 我眼里映出你走过的每片叶子。
lines.en: Every leaf you've crossed is mirrored in my eyes.
Fixes you with a glowing gaze.

lines.zh: 它用绿叶般的眼睛看你
lines.en: It looks at you with leaf-green eyes.
It tilts its head as if listening to you.

lines.zh: 它的目光落在你的伤口
lines.en: Its gaze falls on your wounds.
It looks up, waiting for you to speak.
It recognizes the arcane essence on you.
It stares at the tome in your hand.
It blinks once as a greeting.

lines.zh: 它的视线跟着你的手势

lines.en: The forest's borrowed power just snapped.
A leaf fell off and it stings.

lines.zh: 诱人树叶晃动，发出沙沙声。
闪烁绿光，引诱生物靠近。
用治愈之光轻触受伤者。
在树枝间跳跃，寻找食物。
散发神秘气息，吸引猎物。
用魔法果实引诱冒险者。
在月光下闪烁，引人注意。
用魔法之吻唤醒沉睡者。
藤蔓缠绕，试图绊倒对手。
用能量球轰击，击退敌人。
在月光下低语，表达爱意。
共同守护森林，结为伴侣。
共享魔法果实，加深情感。
在树洞中相依，孕育后代。
共同抵抗外敌，守护家园。
在月光下交配，延续种族。
它轻盈地跳到你肩上，用小爪轻轻拍你。
lines.en: It lightly hops onto your shoulder and pats you with its small paws.

lines.zh: 它的双眼闪烁着森林之光，仿佛能看透一切。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with the light of the forest, seeming to see through everything.

lines.zh: 魔宠轻轻舔你的手，表示友好。
lines.en: The familiar gently licks your hand in a friendly gesture.

lines.zh: 它用树叶遮住你的视线，仿佛一个顽皮的小精灵。
lines.en: It uses leaves to遮住你的视线，仿佛一个顽皮的小精灵。

lines.zh: 魔宠欢快地围着你转圈，似乎很高兴见到你。
lines.en: The familiar happily circles around you, seeming delighted to see you.

lines.zh: 它用树枝轻轻碰你的脸颊。
lines.en: It gently touches your cheek with a twig.

lines.zh: 森林魔宠发出沙沙声，似乎在表达感谢。
lines.en: The forest familiar makes a rustling sound, as if in thanks.

lines.zh: 魔宠用树叶轻拂你的手臂，让你感到舒适。
lines.en: The familiar brushes your arm with leaves, making you feel comfortable.

lines.zh: 它舔了舔你的手指，表示信任。
lines.en: It licks your fingers, showing trust.

lines.zh: 魔宠用小蹄轻轻敲打你的手掌。
lines.en: The familiar taps your palm with its small hooves

lines.zh: 它用锐利的目光锁定目标，眼中满是决心。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze locks onto the target, its eyes filled with resolve.

lines.zh: 魔宠发出低沉的吟唱，似乎在呼唤同伴。
lines.en: It emits a low chant, as if calling for companions.

lines.zh: 它舔了舔嘴唇，显然对即将捕获的猎物垂涎欲滴。
lines.en: It licks its lips, clearly salivating at the impending prey.

lines.zh: 魔宠的眼睛闪烁着绿色的光芒，似乎在寻找魔力。
lines.en: Its eyes flash green, as if searching for magic.

lines.zh: 它发出低吼，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: It growls lowly, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 魔宠开始环绕目标，寻找最佳攻击位置。
lines.en: It circles the target, searching for the best attack position.

lines.zh: 它轻巧地跳跃，迅速接近目标。
lines.en: It jumps lightly, quickly closing the distance to the target.

lines.zh: 魔宠眼中闪现智慧的光芒，似乎在计划着什么。
lines.en: Intelligent light flashes in its eyes, as if planning something.

lines.zh: 它开始吟唱古老的咒语，准备施展法术。
lines.en: It begins to chant an ancient spell, preparing to cast a spell.

lines.zh: 魔宠伸出前爪，似乎要抓住目标。
lines.en: It extends its front claws, as if to grab the target
It draws the enemy into its sight.
It steps in front of you first.

lines.zh: 它的目光始终锁定在目标身上，毫不动摇。
lines.en: Its gaze remains fixed on the target, unwavering.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴轻轻摆动，似乎在引导你瞄准。
lines.en: It wags its tail gently, guiding you to aim.

lines.zh: 魔宠发出轻声的嘶嘶声，似乎在警告你。
它用耳朵转动，似乎在捕捉周围的动静。
lines.en: It turns its ears, listening for any movements.

lines.zh: 魔宠的眼睛开始发光，表明它已经锁定目标。
lines.en: Its eyes begin to glow, indicating it has locked on to the target.

lines.zh: 它开始用前爪触摸你的手，似乎在指导。
lines.en: It touches your hand with its front claws, guiding you.

lines.zh: 魔宠用尾巴指向目标，示意你注意。
lines.en: It points with its tail, directing your attention.

lines.zh: 它用小蹄子轻轻踩你，让你更接近目标。
lines.en: It gently nudges you with its hooves, bringing you closer to the target.

lines.zh: 魔宠发出轻轻的咆哮，似乎在鼓励你。
lines.en: It lets out a soft roar, encouraging you.

lines.zh: 它发出轻声的呜咽，似乎在请求你帮助瞄准。
lines.en: It makes a soft whimpering sound, as if asking for your help in aiming.
It traces a rune circle on the ground.
It drops its voice into a chant.
Green light gathers at its claws.

lines.zh: 它等你给出出手的时机
lines.en: It waits for your signal to strike.
Releasing wind blades to cut the opponent!

lines.zh: 林间光斑聚成它的形状
lines.en: Forest light pools into its shape.
The tome opens and a page lights up.
It opens its eyes among the roots.
It steps out of an old tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 受伤了，主人快来，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, master come quick! — and the fire makes it worse.
